import json,urllib.request

variants=[
 "deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017-abliterated:thinking",
 "openai/deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017-abliterated:thinking",
 "deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017-uncensored",
 "openai/deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017-uncensored",
 "deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017-abliterated:thinking",
 "deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017-abliterated",
 "openai/deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017-abliterated",
]
print(f"{'STRING':66} HASIL")
for m in variants:
    p={"model":m,"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}],"max_tokens":200}
    r=urllib.request.Request("https://obscurify.ai/v1/chat/completions",data=json.dumps(p).encode(),
      headers={"Authorization":f"Bearer {OB}","Content-Type":"application/json"})
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(r,timeout=120) as x: d=json.load(x)
        c=(d['choices'][0]['message'].get('content') or '')[:25]
        print(f"{m:66} ✅ 200 {c!r}")
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        print(f"{m:66} ❌ {e.code} {e.read().decode()[:50]}")
PY
